NewsArticle.Title: Dark Ages Free Anniversary Expansion
NewsArticle.Content: ... August - October Celebrate Dark Ages 1-year anniversary with a Free Expansion! Nexon creates the features you've dreamed of: New Features - New Advanced Class: Masters - New Spell Effects with New Engine [image [1,](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/protect.html) [2,](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/mana.html) [3.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/faerie.html)] - New Story-driven Quests - New Epic Events - New [Role-playing Contests](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_contest.html) - New Items - New Monsters [image [1,](http://www.darkages.com/2000/image/play/m_death_dragon.gif) [2.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/image/play/m_atavism.gif)] - New Realms, including underwater [[screenshot](http://www.darkages.com/2000/image/screen/s_sea.gif)] - Necromancy for Wizards ... and more! Player Power - Player-Controlled Arenas & Duels - Player-Controlled [Monastery](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/s_training.html) for Monks - Player-Controlled [Politics](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_politics.html) Enhancements - Player-Controlled [Religion](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_religion.html) Enhancements - Player-Controlled Mentoring Bonus ... and, of course, continuation of our existing: - Six monthly Director-judged [role-playing contests](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_contest.html) - Player-Created [Library](http://www.darkages.com/2000/community/temuair), edited and maintained by the Director. - Player-Controlled [Fair](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/s_delay.html) - Player-Controlled [Engagement and Marriages](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_love.html) - Player-Controlled [Religious Ceremonies and Quests](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/s_glolica.html) - Player-Controlled College - Player-Created [Guilds](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_guild.html) and Events ... [and more!](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/index_feature.html) New elements that kindle Dark Ages as the "bright light of online adventure," GamePro Magazine We will release and tune each feature throughout August - October to ensure continuous new entertainment and high-quality integration into Dark Ages. As we release each feature, I'll write details. To receive news first, subscribe to free Dark Ages News by e-mail at [www.DarkAges.com/news](http://www.darkages.com/news). It continues to be a supreme joy to create and enhance Dark Ages, a world to live in. Dave Kennerly Game Director August 2, 2000
